# Checklist

- [x] I want to add a new team
- [ ] I have started this PR from a branch, not a fork
- [ ] I have used `pixi run create_new_team <name>` or equivalent
- [ ] I have chosen a charter type
- [ ] I have recorded the approved charter in `details` or a Markdown document in this repository linked from `details`, covering the team's role, responsibilities, scope, and any team-specific membership provisions, with references to applicable governance rules
- [ ] The proposed team members have consented
- [ ] The team creation has been approved
- [ ] I have added the approval link to the team record's `links`
- [ ] CI is passing

If this PR follows an approved team request issue, close that issue as completed once this PR merges. Rejected or withdrawn requests can be closed without a team-record PR.
